metadata.article_title: Commencement of winding up by Tribunal.

article.title: Commencement of winding up by Tribunal.
article.content: The winding up of a company by the Tribunal under this Act shall be deemed to commence at the time of the presentation of the petition for the winding up.]
article.html:
3572[Commencement of winding up by Tribunal.

Section 357 · Chapter XX · Part III · page 195 of the Act

The winding up of a company by the Tribunal under this Act shall be deemed to commence at the time of the presentation of the petition for the winding up.]

2 Subs. by Act 31 of 2016, s. 255 and the Eleventh Schedule, for section 357 (w.e.f. 15-11-2016).
